llm_text: ECMiner™ visually guides data processing through a series of nodes, where each row represents a different node type and its corresponding column entries indicate whether input/output connections are allowed or not for that specific node. This structure helps users understand the flow and connectivity of data within the system. Key roles: Rows represent types of nodes like Input, Preprocessing, Chart, Modeling, Output, and ModelNode; columns show connection status between nodes. The visualization aids in managing data flow and model building processes effectively.

llm_text: The table outlines a step-by-step guide for configuring options when executing a folder, including specifying the input folder, filtering files based on their extensions or names, setting input/output nodes, and enabling logging for folder execution processes. Each row represents a specific configuration option, while columns detail the option name, description, and instructions for implementation.
table_html:
[PRECEDING_TEXT] (4) Follow the following steps to set the options for the Folder Execute. [TABLE_HTML]
Steps Setting name Description
(1) Input Folder Type in the folder directory or click the right search button to find.
(2) Filter Option File Extension Type in the file extension of the files within the executing folder.
(3) File Name Type in the common file name within the executing folder.
(4) Input/Output Settings Set the Input and Output node within the executing project file by clicking the Input Node Setting and Output Node Setting. Click the Output Node Delete to delete the inserted output node settings.
(5) Folder Execution Option Log file of the folder execution process can be saved by setting the Folder Execution Options. (Not required)

llm_text: The table outlines various settings for logging in ECMiner, including where logs are stored, how they are rotated, archived, and formatted, along with the default levels and times used for these operations. Rows represent different logging options, while columns detail their respective descriptions and default values.
table_html:
[PRECEDING_TEXT] [image:rId56] [TABLE_HTML]
File The default log file storage path is the ECMiner™ installation location.
Rotation Logs can be rotated daily, weekly, or monthly, with the default set to never.
Archive Log file names can be based on numbers or timestamps, with timestamps as the default.
Level Only logs at or above the specified level are recorded, with trace capturing the most details.
Times The reference time for log rotation defaults to local time.
Format Logs are stored in the format "[%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%i][%q][%s] %t" by default. * %s : Log record source %t: Log record
